summary: This note is an excerpt from a novel (labeled 'Book 4 — part 37') that moves between two threads: a character speculating about a hyper-rich patron paying people to mess around with another wealthy person, and a massive in-game war in an online game. Anda and Lucy, players at a Fahrenheit guild, lead an assault on a cottage guarded by about forty or fifty mercenaries, with Lucy acting as designated general and rallying hundreds of players over voice chat. The excerpt also includes a short passage about Yuki seeing Monet's 'Impression, Sunrise' in 2013 and a brief note on the cost of a hotel in Bratislava.
one_line: Fiction excerpt in which players Anda and Lucy lead a Fahrenheit assault on a mercenary-guarded cottage in an online game.
key_facts: Lucy is the designated general of the Fahrenheit forces in the assault on the cottage.
The cottage is ringed with forty or fifty guards carrying bows, spells and spears in entrenched positions.
Anda uses a scrying scroll to examine the inventories of the guards around the corner.
The guards are carrying spells and guarding BFGs, including possibly the fabled BFG10K.
The BFG10K was removed from the game economy not long after gameday one as too disruptive to the balance of power.
Lucy negotiated a bonus of a million gold and three missions' worth of cash if the team makes it.
The Fahrenheits are taking payment in gold and will arrive in an hour, according to Lucy.
Hundreds of players are converging on this shard to square off against the ranked mercenaries guarding the cottage.
One of the gamers from Fahrenheit Island brings a team flag, a long spear with a magical standard, for Lucy to carry.
A character speculates that a hot dog and a Coke cost a thousand bucks on the space station.
A character suggests someone very rich, such as a Saudi, Japanese or Russian mafia figure, is paying people to mess around with another rich person.
In 2013, Yuki waited in line for hours to see the original 'Impression, Sunrise' painting up close.
Yuki had been on holiday in Bratislava, where a posh hotel room cost ten quid.
Lucy shouts 'GO GO GO!' and the troops charge, with Anda roaring too.
Voice chat carries hundreds of unmuted players in bedrooms around the world.
